mapper.sql: jd.id as job_definition_id, wf.id as workflow_definition_id, wf.workflow_code, wf.enabled as workflow_enabled, wf.version as workflow_version, wf.tenant_id, jd.version as job_definition_version, jd.job_code, wf.schedule_type, wf.schedule_expr, wf.timezone, wf.trigger_mode, wf.calendar_code, coalesce(bc.catch_up_policy, 'NONE') as catch_up_policy, coalesce(bc.catch_up_max_days, 0) as catch_up_max_days, wf.depends_on_job_code, case when exists ( select 1 from batch.job_dependency jdep where jdep.tenant_id = jd.tenant_id and jdep.downstream_job_code = jd.job_code ) then coalesce(( select string_agg(jdep.upstream_job_code, chr(31) order by jdep.dependency_order) from batch.job_dependency jdep where jdep.tenant_id = jd.tenant_id and jdep.downstream_job_code = jd.job_code and jdep.biz_date_alignment = 'SAME_DAY' ), '') else wf.depends_on_job_code end as depends_on_job_codes, (coalesce(jd.enabled, true) and wf.enabled and wf.schedule_enabled) as enabled
mapper.select:
select
from batch.workflow_definition wf left join batch.job_definition jd on jd.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id and ( wf.single_job_definition_id = jd.id ) join batch.tenant t on t.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id and t.status != 'SUSPENDED' left join batch.business_calendar bc on bc.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id and bc.calendar_code = wf.calendar_code and bc.enabled = true where (jd.id is null or jd.enabled = true) and wf.enabled = true and wf.schedule_enabled = true and wf.version = ( select max(latest.version) from batch.workflow_definition latest where latest.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id and latest.workflow_code = wf.workflow_code ) and wf.schedule_type in ('CRON', 'FIXED_RATE') and wf.trigger_mode in ('SCHEDULED', 'MIXED') order by wf.tenant_id, wf.workflow_code

select
from batch.workflow_definition wf left join batch.job_definition jd on jd.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id and jd.id = wf.single_job_definition_id join batch.tenant tenant on tenant.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id and tenant.status != 'SUSPENDED' left join batch.business_calendar bc on bc.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id and bc.calendar_code = wf.calendar_code and bc.enabled = true where (jd.id is null or jd.enabled = true) and exists ( select 1 from batch.scheduled_occurrence occurrence where occurrence.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id and occurrence.workflow_definition_id = wf.id and occurrence.occurrence_status = 'MISFIRE_PENDING' and occurrence.misfire_detected_at is not null ) order by wf.tenant_id, wf.workflow_code

select
from batch.workflow_definition wf left join batch.job_definition jd on jd.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id and jd.id = wf.single_job_definition_id left join batch.business_calendar bc on bc.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id and bc.calendar_code = wf.calendar_code and bc.enabled = true where wf.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and wf.id = #{workflowDefinitionId}

select
from batch.workflow_definition wf left join batch.job_definition jd on jd.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id and ( wf.single_job_definition_id = jd.id ) left join batch.business_calendar bc on bc.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id and bc.calendar_code = wf.calendar_code and bc.enabled = true where wf.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and wf.workflow_code = #{workflowCode} and wf.version = ( select max(latest.version) from batch.workflow_definition latest where latest.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id and latest.workflow_code = wf.workflow_code )
mapper.update: update batch.workflow_definition wf set schedule_enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where wf.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and wf.workflow_code = #{workflowCode} and wf.version = ( select max(latest.version) from batch.workflow_definition latest where latest.tenant_id = wf.tenant_id and latest.workflow_code = wf.workflow_code )
